objective: Move the owner-facing Mic/STT/TTS test dashboard page out of legacy App.vue into a dedicated typed Vue component while preserving App.vue as the only owner of microphone capture, WAV construction, TTS audio lifecycle and typed speech IPC.
non_goals: Do not change STT/TTS providers, GPU/CPU configuration, microphone permissions, realtime transcription cadence, audio format, speech persistence, voice cloning, model lifecycle or scheduler behavior.
Do not add a dependency, direct renderer network/runtime access, automatic microphone listening, background recording, or real speech/model benchmark against the owner's active desktop.
Do not migrate Live2D or Avatar/Runtime pages in this slice.
contracts: SpeechPage is typed presentation only. It receives bounded speech runtime/status/transcript/audio URL state and emits owner intent or text/toggle updates; it does not import Electron, Node, MediaDevices, direct network APIs, persistence or model runtimes.

App.vue remains the sole owner of MicrophoneRecorder/getUserMedia, AudioWorklet-compatible capture, WAV conversion, transcription/TTS IPC, audio object URL revocation, live-transcript throttling and error logging.
The page does not turn on recording automatically. A microphone capture can start only from the existing explicit owner button/event and its existing duration/size bounds remain unchanged.
The page never receives raw PCM chunks, microphone stream handles, stored voice references, model weights, API keys or hidden model text.
Desktop renderer security tests include the extracted page and preserve the direct-media/IPC boundary.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed IPC and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All Mic/STT/TTS dashboard markup is removed from App.vue and rendered through pages/SpeechPage.vue.
The extracted page preserves explicit start/stop microphone controls, realtime toggle, transcript/correlation status, bounded TTS text input and audio playback view through typed props/emits only.
Dashboard module documentation records SpeechPage as extracted and names remaining legacy pages accurately.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and the repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
